literal.prompt: Какую технику участники курса Fashion and Textile Museum используют вместе с моделированием выкройки, чтобы разрабатывать дизайн одежды в 3D?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Fashion and Textile Museum says pattern modelling and fabric draping are used together to develop fashion designs in 3D (L57). It separately says draping uses fabric directly on a dress stand to make patterns that can later be translated to paper (L55). The Met supplies the close contrast: tailleur likely starts from a flat pattern derived from a sketch, while flou likely evolves on the form (L103). This specific paired use and 3D development are the knowledge being tested; the item no longer asks only for the elementary draping definition.
literalGroups.locator: Fashion and Textile Museum L55-L57; The Met L100-L103

literalGroups.literal: Муляжный метод строит выкройку, когда ткань формируют непосредственно на манекене. Fashion and Textile Museum отмечает, что созданную таким способом выкройку можно затем перевести на бумагу.
literalGroups.locator: It identifies draping as pattern cutting that uses fabric directly on a dress stand to create garment patterns, then states that those patterns can be translated into paper form.

literalGroups.literal: В atelier tailleur модель обычно начинает развиваться как плоская выкройка, выведенная из эскиза.
literalGroups.locator: The atelier tailleur specializes in structured garments; a garment originating there is likely to begin as a flat pattern derived from a sketch.

literalGroups.literal: Полученную на манекене выкройку можно затем перевести в бумажный формат.
literalGroups.locator: The source says patterns created through draping on a dress stand can then be translated into paper form, an additional fact beyond the prompt and answer.

literalGroups.literal: В технике Garment Pleating изделие сначала шьют увеличенного размера, затем складывают и прессуют между бумагой, чтобы закрепить складки.
literalGroups.locator: It describes the Garment Pleating process: garments are constructed larger, then precisely folded, ironed, and pressed between paper to set pleats.

literalGroups.literal: Туаль — прототип одежды или предварительный трёхмерный эскиз; для haute couture или асимметричного дизайна The Met описывает полный вариант.
literalGroups.locator: The source defines toile as a prototype garment or preliminary 3D sketch and describes a full toile for haute couture and asymmetrical designs.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: After fabric is draped on the dress stand and a pattern is created, that pattern can be translated to paper.

absoluteDifficulty.ground: The item asks for a specific technical pairing—pattern modelling with fabric draping—to develop designs in 3D, rather than merely defining draping. The learner must distinguish that pairing from flat sketch-derived construction, pleating, and toile prototyping. This is a specialized relationship within garment construction, not difficulty inferred from an unfamiliar word.
